sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (read in memory with zipfile): sheet 'Quality Checks' row 29 (check 28: 'No two criteria grade the same thing twice, subsume each other, or demand incompatible products.'); sheet 'Internal Quality Checks' row 29 annotation 'Mukesh - we usually combine the multiple verifeirs in one flow , we just test a flow and mutltiple things are there so we dont need to retest it again as spetaet file'
.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r6/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (including the known false positive 'One criterion covering a whole flow')
evidence:
Most of the rubric is carefully partitioned. pol_live_board and pol_live_thread say arrival speed is graded only in Functional, and long_thread owns the scrolled-up case (polish/judge.toml:25,34). hro_drafts defers sent-text-after-reload to hro_messaging (functional/judge.toml:132). hro_pol_failed_send defers note drafts (polish:52). Aud's and anonymous message-send replays are split between hro_messaging and hro_readonly_roles. Tomas's staff-write replays (readonly_roles) and staff-read replays (hro_candidate) are split. Intake's restart leg compares against the recorded baseline (functional:33), following Colderwater lesson 16. hro_undo leaves out legs whose trigger is Mei's re-order, reject or reopen (functional:87). readonly_roles keeps a refusal leg only 'for a request kind whose staff control succeeded in this session (otherwise ... that feature is graded in its own criterion)' (functional:114). functional/prompt.md:21 states 'opening is graded only in hro_intake_restart'. The polish and visual prompts say 'Do not deduct the same observed defect in more than one row'. I found no pair of criteria that asks for products that can't both be built: 'after reopening the reason is gone', 'undoing the reopening puts C back in Rejected with its reason' and Activity keeping the old reason are explicitly reconciled (functional:51). Cleared-after-send versus failed-send-kept, and per-user drafts, are also compatible.
DEFECT: hro_manager_roles (functional/judge.toml:105) grades features that other criteria own a second time, through bar-named Recruiter controls that have no leave-out clause. Bar: 'Her Applied to Screen, Screen to Interview and Interview to Screen, rejecting a Screen card, re-ordering within Applied, reopening the Screen rejection, opening a job and adding a candidate are each refused with nothing changed (UI or replay); Rafael's identical requests are the control.' and 'Her multi-card move of an Offer card with a Screen card is refused with neither card moved, while Rafael's identical move succeeds.' functional/prompt.md:17 requires 'Every refusal leg needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this session'. prompt.md:21 says every behaviour the Bar names 'is graded here and is never left out'. So inside manager_roles the following are each required again: Rafael's job opening (prompt.md:21 itself says 'opening is graded only in hro_intake_restart'), his re-order within Applied (hro_moves, functional:42, 'A card's place within a stage changes up and down'), his cross-stage multi-card move (hro_bulk, functional:78, 'V and A2 from different stages land together') and his reopen to the rejected-from stage (hro_reject_reopen, functional:51). Its sibling hro_readonly_roles (functional:114) explicitly drops a refusal leg whose staff control failed. The two role criteria handle the same situation inconsistently, which is the double penalty in lesson 16. The same pattern, a bar-named leg that duplicates another criterion's core observable, also appears in manager_roles' 'Ingrid's late-stage moves, re-orders, rejections from Interview and Offer and their reopenings all succeed' and in hro_interview_places' 'Re-ordering inside the full Interview is allowed' (functional:69). An app with no working re-order therefore loses hro_moves (4) + hro_manager_roles (4) + hro_interview_places (5.5) = 13.5/61 of the functional weight. The criterion-weight comment (functional:25) values re-order at 1.5 in hro_moves.
Lower-risk notes (not the basis of the Fail): pol_live_board and pol_live_thread score 0 when no update arrives within 60 s (polish:25,34). That follows unavoidably from the 'no credit for a dead feature' rule, because preservation cannot be observed without an update, and the 60-second window already keeps speed out of polish. hro_candidate's wording sequence (functional:159) needs reject, reopen and moves to Hired to work. prompt.md:21's setup exemption lists '(adding a candidate, a single move, re-ordering, undo)' but not reject or reopen, so whether a reopen failure is left out there is ambiguous. In the visual rubric, hro_vis_type's 'deliberate hierarchy' slightly overlaps hro_vis_hierarchy. The template's typography and hierarchy rows overlap in the same way, and visual/prompt.md:14 forbids deducting one defect in two rows, so I treat this as a Note. Undo of a multi-card move, undo of a rejection or reopening, and undo or reopen being refused when Interview is full are separately stated public promises (hireops_rules.md:64-66,92-104), not duplicates. No runtime evidence bears on this row. The finding is source-level, and no run was made or cited.
counterexample: Take the golden app with one change: the Recruiter's open-job request fails (server 500). Everything else stays correct. hro_intake_restart correctly scores 0 (opening is 'graded only in hro_intake_restart', prompt.md:21). hro_manager_roles falls back to the seeded Product Designer job and Yuki. But the bar leg 'opening a job ... refused ...; Rafael's identical requests are the control' has no successful control, so it cannot pass, and the bar forbids leaving it out. That costs another 4/61 for the same defect. hro_readonly_roles, by contrast, drops the identical open-job refusal leg and does not penalize it. Similarly, an otherwise-golden app without within-stage re-order fails hro_moves, hro_manager_roles (Ingrid's re-orders and Rafael's Applied re-order control) and hro_interview_places (re-order inside full Interview): 13.5/61 for one missing feature.
suggested_fix: In hro_manager_roles, add readonly_roles' clause: a refusal leg exists only when Rafael's same-kind control succeeded in this session (that feature is graded in its own criterion). Grade Ingrid's allowed moves, re-orders, rejections and reopenings relative to the same action succeeding for Rafael. Also consider that relative wording for hro_interview_places' re-order leg.
